notes.title: UPDATE! Version 1.6 is live!
notes.content:
Hey! Dr. Dungeon - Rob here, went through 1.5 to 1.6!

- 1.6 has all the 1.4 stuff plus a few bells & whistles:

- Clarified even more about getting the useful item earlier.
  (It involves quick travel as at first glance it seems like
   the function isn't in the game, but it is as part of a quest
   and is a pretty interesting implimentation. Enjoy!)

- Fixed a few minor bugs involving inventory and several quest items.

- Added several extra messages throughout that assist the player to
  not accidentally over-look or miss certain quest clues.

- Plus did several extra run-throughs to insure all is well.

 - If you fall in love with Wendy, I'm sorry I can't give you her phone
   number as she's a fictinal character. :)

As always, will continue to listen to feedback and thank you for playing!  Dr. D.

notes.title: UPDATE! Version 1.4 Coming soon!
notes.content:
Based on user feedback and general tweaks:

- Portraits have been modified to reflect the overall style
  of the game. They are more like stenciled paintings now.
  (screenshots are up now)

- Ranged weapons were a bit over-powered. Now adjusted.

- Steal skill is better now. The check no longer occurs
  upon taking the object, but on putting it in your
  inventory and walking away. Let's you inspect the goods. :)

- Player is occasionally reminded to camp. This is important
  for the dream sequences and moving the story along.

- An important and useful item is now easier to get near the
  early parts of the game, involving the Water Witch.

 - Lantern now properly lights up monsters at night and in
   dungeons, making targeting much easier.

This should be up soon - maybe a day or two. Will definitely announce!
Further feedback is always welcome. Enjoy! - Dr. D.
